# Mozilla Firefox
> Firefox is a free web browser from Mozilla, a non-profit focused on privacy, security, and internet health.

Mozilla’s Firefox site provides browser downloads, feature overviews, release channels, enterprise offerings, privacy resources, and links to support, add-ons, and the broader Mozilla community.

## Downloads
- [Download Firefox](https://www.mozilla.com/thanks/): Main Firefox download page for supported desktop and mobile platforms.
- [Windows Download](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/download/windows/): Download Firefox for Windows systems.
- [macOS Download](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/download/mac/): Download Firefox for macOS.
- [iOS Download](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/download/ios/): Get Firefox for iPhone and iPad.
- [Android Download](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/download/android/): Get Firefox for Android devices.
- [Linux Download](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/download/linux/): Download Firefox for Linux distributions.
- [Custom Download Options](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/download/all/): Access manual downloads for platforms, languages, and architectures.
- [Firefox ESR 64-bit](https://download.mozilla.org/?product=firefox-esr115-latest-ssl&os=win64&lang=en-US): Direct download for the Extended Support Release on Windows 64-bit.

## Browser Platforms
- [Desktop Browser](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/browsers/desktop/): Overview of Firefox for desktop computers.
- [Mobile Browser](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/browsers/mobile/): Overview of Firefox for smartphones and tablets.
- [Firefox for Business](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/browsers/enterprise/): Enterprise-focused Firefox deployment and management information.
- [Compare Browsers](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/compare/): Compare Firefox with other major browsers.
- [Learn More](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/more/): Additional Firefox product and educational resources.

## Features
- [Firefox Features](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/features/): Overview of Firefox privacy, security, and productivity features.
- [Fingerprint Blocking](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/features/block-fingerprinting/): Explains Firefox protections against browser fingerprinting.
- [Ad Tracker Blocking](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/features/adblocker/): Describes Firefox blocking of ad trackers and related privacy protections.
- [Private Browsing Mode](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/features/private-browsing/): Overview of Firefox private browsing capabilities.
- [Password Manager](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/features/password-manager/): Details Firefox’s built-in password management tools.
- [Data Protection](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/user-privacy/): Information about Firefox privacy and user data protection.

## Release Channels
- [Release Notes](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/firefox/notes/): Official Firefox release notes and version changes.
- [Nightly](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/channel/desktop/#nightly): Early development builds for testing upcoming Firefox changes.
- [Beta](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/channel/desktop/#beta): Preview builds for testing features before stable release.
- [Developer Edition](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/channel/desktop/developer/): Firefox build tailored for web developers.
- [Unsupported Windows Notice](https://support.mozilla.org/kb/firefox-users-windows-7-8-and-81-moving-extended-support): Support article about Firefox support changes for older Windows versions.

## Support and Help
- [Firefox Support](https://support.mozilla.org/): Official support portal for Firefox help articles and troubleshooting.
- [Mozilla Connect](https://connect.mozilla.org/): Community feedback platform for Firefox ideas and product discussions.
- [Mozilla Community](https://community.mozilla.org/): Community hub for Mozilla participation and events.
- [Contribute](https://www.mozilla.org/contribute/): Ways to contribute to Mozilla projects and initiatives.

## Add-ons and Ecosystem
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/): Extensions and themes for customizing Firefox.
- [Firefox Blog](https://blog.mozilla.org/en/category/firefox/): News, announcements, and stories about Firefox.
- [Firefox Podcasts](https://www.youtube.com/@firefox/podcasts): Firefox podcast content published on YouTube.

## Product Navigation
- [Home](https://www.mozilla.com/): Firefox homepage with downloads, features, and product navigation.
- [Features Overview](https://www.mozilla.com/en-US/features/): Central landing page for Firefox feature categories.
- [Resources](https://www.mozilla.com/#m24-c-menu-panel-resources): On-page resources navigation panel from the main site.
- [Download Section](https://www.mozilla.com/thanks/): Primary entry point for obtaining Firefox builds.
